release_notes: Release v1.1.27: Added 100% offline word-by-word pronunciation audio download in Settings with Supabase upload pipeline in scripts/scrape_wbw_audio.py; authentic Hizb markers in two-page tablet outer margins and soft grey line highlighting in single-page view; interactive Ayah marker popup with recitation playback, Tafsir Al-Muyassar, and bookmarking; and full-featured Quran Range Audio Player supporting Surah-to-Surah, Juz-to-Juz, Quarter-to-Quarter, Ayah-to-Ayah, and Page-to-Page playback.
